attempts.text:
**Recommended plan:** Make one round trip each to Naukunda farm and Dupcheshwar temple, rescuing 8 adults, and defer the 2 adults at Bidur village to a later wave.

The Trishuli–Naukunda road is impassable, so Naukunda must be reached through Gosaikunda temple. All drop-offs must be at Trishuli shelter, so every trip has to return there.

| Location | Adults | Round trip | Cost to defer everyone | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Naukunda farm | 4 | 46 min | 80 | Rescue (saves 34) |
| Dupcheshwar temple | 4 | 72 min | 80 | Rescue (saves 8) |
| Bidur village | 2 | 116 min | 40 | Defer (saves 76) |

I also checked the alternatives, and all cost more:
- **Rescue everyone:** This takes 3 trips and 234 min of driving.
- **Collect Bidur's 2 adults and 2 from Dupcheshwar on one trip:** With the Naukunda trip and 2 Dupcheshwar adults deferred, this costs 46 + 116 + 40 = 202.
- **Make only the Naukunda trip:** Deferring the other 6 adults costs 46 + 120 = 166.

**Total cost:**
- **Driving:** 46 + 72 = 118 min
- **Deferral penalty:** 2 adults × 20 = 40
- **Total:** 158
